envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: operator asked the OMP status line to show the active persona's identity; name and mark are reachable through omp's documented setStatus + status segment, color is not
envelope.cause: operator request 2026-09-28: persona identity in the OMP status line

payload.gloss: the running persona's name and mark emoji shown in the harness status line so the operator sees which persona a session runs; projected from the agent cell into that persona's own launch scope, so placement names the persona and nothing asks at runtime; shown only in the top-level interactive session, never a subagent's; its own module, apart from guardrails and session hooks; carries no hue where the harness strips color (omp strips it from extension status text)
